title: Phase 0 cached implementation claims
description: Sample state for a read-only prototype. Every restored claim remains unvalidated with unknown freshness. This is not an evidence or verification result schema.
$comment: The panel requires project_id to match the loaded configuration and rejects duplicate or unknown milestone IDs. uniqueItems checks whole-object equality only and does not enforce ID uniqueness. Missing milestones default to planned. No edited JSON value grants verification.
